title: Invariant of the outer state
statement: Let $s,w,u,v,M$ be natural numbers with $u<2^w$, $v<2^w$, and $M\le 2^w$. The state obtained from the outer state with parameters $s,w,u,v,M$ by setting its level register to $w$ has all scratch, input-length, exponent, power, loop, and popped-endpoint registers equal to zero; its radius and width registers are $s$ and $w$, its code-bound register is $2^w$, its source and target registers are less than $2^w$, its midpoint register is at most $2^w$, its level register is $w$, its endpoint stack is less than $2^{w(w-w)}$, and its phase stack is less than $2^{w-w}$.
